name: harness-error-unavailable
notes: Sources/PhoneDSHAgentCore/AgentHarness.swift:490-494 (a transport loss ends the stream with unavailable and the caller re-subscribes from its last durable seq) and DSHRemoteHarness.swift:262-265 (retry exhaustion surfaces unavailable). Only unavailable and rate_limited are retryable (ProviderError.swift:31-37); the DSH transport maps gateway/internal and its siblings to unavailable (DSHRemoteTransport.swift:53-69).
